To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mechanical characteristics of adobe walls are strongly influenced by the mechanical properties of both the brick and the mortar composing the wall.

the nonlinear analyses of adobe masonry walls reinforced with fiberglass mesh show that the global behavior of the wall is strongly affected by the ratio between mortar properties and brick properties.

(i) unreinforced adobe masonry walls exhibit a brittle behavior, while the use of fiberglass mesh improves the ductility of the walls, (ii) the mechanical properties of adobe masonry materials influence the structural behavior, and (iii) the use of fiberglass reinforcement improves the strength and ductility of adobe walls.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) the development of an experimental program to investigate the mechanical behavior of adobe masonry walls reinforced with fiberglass mesh, (2) the development of a numerical model of an adobe masonry wall reinforced with fiberglass mesh and (3) the development of nonlinear static and dynamic analyses of adobe masonic walls.
the development of a nonlinear analysis of adobe structures and with the assessment of the effectiveness of a new seismic reinforcement technique for adobe masonry walls.

(i) the development of a numerical model of an adobe structural member; (ii) the analysis of the influence of the mechanical properties of materials on structural response of adobe masonry walls; and (iii) the evaluation of the effectiveness of the reinforcement with fiberglass mesh.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanical properties of adobe masonry walls can be accurately predicted by the nonlinear analyses.
the use of fiberglass mesh is not able to increase the structural response of the wall in terms of both strength and ductility, but the reinforcement is still able to reduce the wall deformation.
, when considering the same mortar properties, the use of a fiberglass mesh reinforcement is beneficial to the overall structural response.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the mechanical properties of adobe masonry are strongly influenced by the ratio between mortar strength and brick compressive strength, and that this ratio has to be considered in the design of adobe masonries.
adobe masonry structures are very sensitive to the ratio between mortar properties and brick mechanical properties.
, when increasing the mortar strength, a significant increase of the global response of adobe walls is obtained.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reinforcement with fiberglass mesh improves the global behavior of the walls, especially when the mortar is weaker than the bricks.
the mechanical properties of both mortar and adobe bricks influence the overall behavior of the wall in terms of strength, stiffness and ductility.

the mechanical properties of mortar have a great influence on the global response of unreinforced adobe masonry structures, and that the reinforcement with fiberglass mesh can significantly increase the strength and the ductility of the walls.
